Hi Dana — thanks for sending the filled form. I've opened an internal ops request and attached the intake. A few quick clarifications so we set expectations correctly:

- We support two options depending on compliance review: (a) suppress the single-thread from searchable/analytics indexes while retaining an immutable deletion marker in primary logs, or (b) perform a targeted deletion from long-term archival logs where policy permits. Full cryptographic immutability or backups may take longer to align with our archival vendors.
- We'll need the completed DSAR authorization uploaded to DocuSign and confirmation that Everwell legal approves the action.
- Please include the exact message IDs or the UTC timestamp range for the messages to avoid collateral deletions.

I've attached our standard DSAR checklist for your records (DSAR_authorization.pdf). Once Compliance signs off, we'll schedule the operation and provide you a deletion-confirmation artifact (deletion-confirmation.txt) with a timestamp and the internal audit reference.

Marissa Cole
Support Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
